linearized_noise_validation.scope: First-order parameter displacement at the generating model. Diagnostic only; these are not nonlinear fitted recoveries and do not validate cold-start convergence.

reduction_method: Backward deletion of complete signed projector groups or condenser aperture pairs, followed by fresh nonlinear recovery. The 90- and 92-image candidates reached the prefield uncertainty limit; four orthogonal-tilt images at an existing projector setting provide margin. This is a local design search, not an exhaustive image-count proof.
scope: Local synthetic recovery and independent detector-noise trials with the acquisition frozen. Each repeat first fits the 92-image subset from independent engineering guesses, then adds four images and runs three local joint starts. No earlier-fit prior enters the objective. The fresh 96-image notebook run uses independent engineering guesses for the full staged procedure. Exposure/dose is unchanged. The 12 prediction images are excluded from fitting. One-sigma uncertainty targets are not guaranteed absolute-error limits. This is the smallest retained acquisition validated in this reduction study, not a proof of a global image-count minimum or unique real microscope geometry.

source_z_followup.description: Eight condenser follow-up images selected to reduce the two source-waist position variances, then tested using coherent Gaussian images and a joint refit. The original 96 noisy fitting images and 12 prediction images are preserved exactly.
source_z_followup.control_units: Relative synthetic excitation commands, not microscope hardware current values.
source_z_followup.source_definition: Effective Gaussian source waist, not the physical emitter tip.
source_z_followup.adaptive_initialization: Existing 96-image calibration, plus/minus two source-position standard deviations along the correlated parameter direction. All 104 original image measurements refitted jointly; no old-fit covariance prior.
source_z_followup.independent_initialization: The four original engineering condenser starts and subsequent joint attempt failed the noise-level acceptance test on the expanded dataset. This validates an adaptive follow-up to the existing 96-image calibration, not a replacement cold-start procedure.

linearized_noise_comparison.scope: Paired first-order displacement at generating model, measured from independent Poisson/read-noise realizations of coherent Gaussian image means. Original 96 images are identical within each comparison. This is not 64 nonlinear or cold-start fits. Selection was frozen before reading truth.

source_z_followup.scope: One nonlinear synthetic follow-up, three local starts and 64 paired linearized noise trials. Reduces expected uncertainty; does not guarantee an absolute error bound or prove global uniqueness. The maintained notebook recipe is unchanged.
